status_note: Still open on main (a4d8e00342d0): the fp impls of `add`, `subtract` and `multiply` ([`functions_arithmetic.yaml` L45-L62](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/a4d8e00342d0/extensions/functions_arithmetic.yaml#L45-L62), [`functions_arithmetic.yaml` L103-L120](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/a4d8e00342d0/extensions/functions_arithmetic.yaml#L103-L120), [`functions_arithmetic.yaml` L161-L178](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/a4d8e00342d0/extensions/functions_arithmetic.yaml#L161-L178)) take `rounding` only, while `divide` ([`functions_arithmetic.yaml` L180-L187](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/blob/a4d8e00342d0/extensions/functions_arithmetic.yaml#L180-L187)) has `on_domain_error`; nothing says `inf - inf` or `0 * inf` gives NaN. Closest issue [#1275](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/issues/1275) (IEEE divide); see also [#996](https://github.com/substrait-io/substrait/issues/996) (options inconsistent across functions).
summary: `add`, `subtract` and `multiply` on `fp32`/`fp64` have only `rounding`. `inf - inf`, `inf + (-inf)` and `0 * inf` have no IEEE value, and the YAML neither says they give NaN nor offers `on_domain_error`, as `divide` and `sqrt` do.
handling: The core allows NaN or a raise (`nan_creation`); the reference raises (#257), and DuckDB's written plan guards these cases.
Could be expressed as: `on_domain_error: [NAN, NULL, ERROR]` on the floating-point `add`, `subtract`, `multiply` and `sum`, as `divide` has.
